Shipping times

Orders placed before 2 pm ship the same day. Most parcels arrive within two to four working days, and express parcels arrive the next day. See our returns policy for what to do when a parcel is late or damaged, and keep your order number at hand.

Tracking from the command line

Developers can track a parcel with our tool. Install it, then run track <order> with your order number to see where the parcel is right now.

npm install @shop/track
track 12345
